name: Vyntage RP
description:
💜💿 Welcome to Vyntage RP!

Welcome to Vyntage RP, an Atlanta-based city bringing the culture, style, and energy of the early-2000s Dirty South back to life.

From the streets and nightlife to businesses, music, fashion, and everyday life, Vyntage captures the nostalgia of Y2K Atlanta while creating a world built around Quality experiences, creativity, and community.

Whether you're building your reputation in the streets, running a business, making connections, or simply enjoying everything the city has to offer, Your story is yours to create.

Welcome to the Dirty South. Welcome to Vyntage.💜
